$comment: Overlay ports: libtorrent is the baseline port plus fix-i2p-stream-buffer-uaf.patch (I2P SAM use-after-free, docs/torrent/libtorrent-i2p-stream-uaf.md); rapidyenc (SIMD yEnc) and par2-turbo (PAR2 verify/repair) have no vcpkg port of their own. The CMake build can FetchContent both, but the hand-maintained src/eMuleQt.sln resolves everything from src/vcpkg_installed/, so without these the MSBuild build silently loses SIMD yEnc decoding and all PAR2 support. Having them here also stops the Windows CI job rebuilding them from source on every run.
